description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of cases based on the presence of a reference answer and a test case. The chart contains three slices, representing the categories “Null”, “Have reference answer”, and “Have test case”. The “Null” slice is colored red and represents approximately 39.2% of the total. The “Have reference answer” slice is colored blue and accounts for roughly 38.9% of the total. Finally, the “Have test case” slice is green and represents approximately 21.9% of the total. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding category and numerical value. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, from largest to smallest proportion.
